lines.text: Solomon stood before the altar in front of all Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven, and prayed to the LORD.
Solomon said God had kept His promise to David, and that the highest heavens and this temple cannot contain Him.
Solomon asked God to keep His eyes on the temple and to hear from Zion when the people pray there.

wrong_details.true: hear from heaven, His dwelling place

lines.text: Solomon asked God to forgive a defeated Israel who returned and prayed, and to give them a new land.

wrong_details.true: restore them to the land He gave to their fathers

lines.text: Solomon said God brought Israel out of Egypt and set them apart as His inheritance, as He spoke through Moses.
